name: Hardware Corner RTX 4060 Ti 16GB local LLM benchmark page (March 2026)
notes: Per-SKU llama.cpp table, page header 'Updated Benchmarks: March 2026'. Single RTX 4060 Ti 16GB (16 GB GDDR6, 288 GB/s stated). Tables: Qwen3 8B Q4_K at 4k/16k/32k/64k (TG 45.8 / 34.3 / 25.5 / 13.0; PP 2,675.2 / 1,480.8 / 760.3 / 392.1), Qwen3 14B Q4_K at 4k/16k/32k (TG 27.4 / 22.4 / 17.9; PP 1,645.7 / 917.6 / 541.4), and gpt-oss 20B MXFP4 at 4k through 128k (TG 63.2 / 57.8 / 51.5 / 41.1 / 31.1; PP 3,274.2 / 2,552.9 / 1,964.9 / 1,332.2 / 780.2). Header '22.4 t/s / 918 t/s on 14B at 16k' matches the 16k cells. No 32B row exists on this page despite the 16 GB. No build hash.
